title: Reserves Reach County Final After Thrilling Semi Win
excerpt: A late point from play sealed a famous victory in Newbridge as the Reserves booked their place in the county final for the first time since 2018.
body:
A late point from play sealed a famous victory in Newbridge on Sunday as the Reserves booked their place in the county final for the first time since 2018.

Trailing by two at half time, the lads dug deep in the second half with the wind at their backs. A goal midway through the half turned the tide, and when Rathangan levelled it late on, it was left to the men in red and black to find one more score.

A huge thank you to the massive crowd who travelled — the county final date will be confirmed by the CCC this week. Keep an eye on the club socials for ticket details.
